name: MSPM0G3518_Q1_RHB
description: TI MSPM0G3518-Q1 Arm Cortex-M0+ MCU, RHB (VQFN-32, 5x5mm body) package, orderable M0G3518QRHBRQ1 -- same die/part number as the project MCU (MSPM0G3518_Q1_PM, REFERENCES.md [44]), swapped to the smaller package option to shrink builds/6s/50A/CAN_485_faraday's 'widest non-isolated part' (docs/tools/isolation_envelope.py), per docs/solutions/architecture-patterns/bom-creepage-audit-can485-faraday.md finding #1. RHB exposes only PA0-PA27 (no Port B/C) -- all 28 signal roles below were re-derived pad-by-pad against that constraint and are NOT a renumbering of the PM pin map.
verification: VERIFIED -- every pad and IOMUX function below is read directly from the local copy of [44] (SLASFA6B) at docs/datasheets/mspm0g3518-q1.pdf: Figure 6-6 '32-pin RHB (0.5mm) (VQFN) Package Diagram' (p.14) for the RHB pin-number -> pad-name map, and Table 6-2 'Pin Attributes' (pp.15-23, the RHB PA0-PA27 rows) for the per-pad IOMUX option list, read from the rendered page images (the multi-package table's RHB/ZAW/YCJ/RGZ/PT/PM/PN/PZ columns do not survive plain pdftotext -layout as separate columns; the PA28-PA31 rows were independently confirmed to have a BLANK RHB column on the same pages, consistent with Figure 6-6 showing only PA0-PA27 -- RHB truly has 28 GPIOs, not 32). Dedicated (non-IOMUX) pins VERIFIED from Figure 6-6: NRST = RHB 3, VDD = RHB 4, VSS = RHB 5, VCORE = RHB 32 (top-left corner label). PROVENANCE: the RHB package/footprint choice itself was already vetted in this repository by a prior generic symbol, `symbols/MSPM0G3518_Q1_RHB.kicad_sym` (generator tag 'serenity_cleanroom_2026_08_03'), authored for an unrelated board and internally named after that board's character call-sign. That name is scrubbed here per this repository's own no-cross-project-naming-leak hygiene; the underlying package/footprint claim (RHB0032E, 5x5mm, Package_DFN_QFN:Texas_RHB0032E_VQFN-32-1EP_5x5mm_P0.5mm_EP3.45x3.45mm) was independently re-verified against [44] Figure 6-6 and REFERENCES.md [44]'s own p.137-139 RHB0032T package-outline citation before reuse, not carried over on trust. A DEFECT was found and fixed in the process: the prior symbol declared 33 pins (an extra, duplicate 'VSS' at pin '33'), one more than RHB's real 32-pin count; that spurious pin does not appear below. SIGNAL-ROLE NAMING AND PIN COORDINATES: to keep this build's existing schematic wiring intact when swapping U1 from MSPM0G3518_Q1_PM to this symbol, every pin below uses the IDENTICAL local (at x y rotation) coordinate, electrical type, and functional-role name as the corresponding pin in symbols/MSPM0G3518_Q1_PM.kicad_sym -- only the physical pin NUMBER changes, to its RHB equivalent. This mirrors the same swap-without-relayout technique that symbols/specs/MSPM0G3518_Q1_PM.json itself documents using when it replaced the S32K144 symbol. Per-signal RHB pad verification: SWCLK=PA20(24), SWDIO=PA19(23) [Table 6-2 p.21, pf2 both]; CAN_TX=PA12(16) [p.19, pf12 CAN0_TX], CAN_RX=PA13(17) [p.19, pf12 CAN0_RX]; RS485_TXD=PA0(1) [p.15, pf2 UART0_TX], RS485_RXD=PA1(2) [p.15, pf2 UART0_RX], RS485_DE_RE=PA6(10) [p.17, pf9 UART0_RTS]; GD_SPI_CS=PA2(6) [p.16, pf5 SPI1_CS0], GD_SPI_SCK=PA17(21) [p.21, pf3 SPI1_SCK], GD_SPI_MISO=PA16(20) [p.20, pf3 SPI1_POCI], GD_SPI_MOSI=PA18(22) [p.21, pf3 SPI1_PICO]; PWM_AH/AL=PA8(12)/PA9(13) [p.18, pf5/pf5 TIMA0_C0/TIMA0_C0N], PWM_BH/BL=PA3(7)/PA4(8) [p.16, pf5/pf5 TIMA0_C1/TIMA0_C1N], PWM_CH/CL=PA10(14)/PA11(15) [p.18-19, pf5/pf5 TIMA0_C2/TIMA0_C2N] -- all three complementary pairs verified on the SAME TIMA0 timer instance, matching the PM design's requirement for one synchronized 3-phase PWM generator, and PA3/PA4, PA8/PA9, PA10/PA11 are each physically adjacent RHB pin pairs (7/8, 12/13, 14/15), incidentally preserving the PM design's low-gate-loop-area adjacency choice without engineering for it; SE_I2C_SCL=PA15(19) [p.20, pf4 I2C1_SCL], SE_I2C_SDA=PA5(9) [p.17, pf4 I2C1_SDA], SE_RST=PA14(18) [plain GPIO, p.20 pf1]; ADC_IU=PA24(28) [p.23], ADC_IV=PA23(27) [p.22], ADC_IW=PA25(29) [p.23], ADC_VBUS=PA21(25) [p.22] -- non-IOMUX analog functions A0_3/A1_12/A0_2/A1_7 respectively, same channel assignments as the PM design. CONFLICT CHECK: all 24 PA pads used above are distinct; PA7, PA22, PA26, PA27 are unused (4 GPIOs spare, matches the audit's finding). FIRMWARE NOTE inherited unchanged from the PM spec: ADC reference must be VDDA (internal), not external VREF -- unaffected by this package swap since PA21/PA23's VREF-/VREF+ alternate functions are simply left unused here as on PM. HAND-AUTHORED SYMBOL, same reason as MSPM0G3518_Q1_PM: kiutils is not installed and pip is not permitted (docs/HANDOFF-mcu-swap-s32k144-to-mspm0g3518.md SS6).
